prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1451; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement is regarding the collision you reported in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Please describe where you were and what you were doing when the collision occurred.

A: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Pearland, in the right lane. I had been waiting maybe thirty seconds when I felt a hard impact from behind.

Q: Did you see the vehicle that struck you before the impact?

A: No. I was looking forward at the light. I only saw it in my mirror after the collision, and it was already too late.

Q: What was the condition of your vehicle after the collision?

A: The rear bumper was pushed in and the trunk would not close properly. My seatbelt locked up, and I was jolted pretty hard against it.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon. My neck was stiff and sore, and the pain went into my shoulders. They diagnosed a neck strain and gave me a prescription for muscle relaxers and some anti-inflammatories.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Yes. Turning my head to the left is difficult, and I get headaches toward the end of the day. I've been doing some physical therapy twice a week.

Q: Have you missed any work because of your injuries?

A: I missed two days and I've been working on a lighter schedule since then.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: No, I think that covers it. I just want to make sure my vehicle repair and medical bills are looked at fairly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.

A: Thank you.
